title: Wild Bill Donovan parachutes in with a butterfly collection for Ho Chi Minh
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Wild Bill Donovan parachutes in with a butterfly collection for Ho Chi Minh, about World War II at Vietnam, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, tells a story about Bill Donovan, the American spy chief, during the Second World War. McMoneagle says that Donovan parachuted into Vietnam with a very rare butterfly collection taped to his chest as a gift for Ho Chi Minh, the Vietnamese leader, which would mean the US had close, friendly contact with him back then.
